{{Quote|Only once before have individual members of both gladiator teams met, that being the 12th Solassi Interzonals Challenge Match two years ago.|A news report included in the fiftieth-anniversary edition of ''Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology''|<ref name="Galladinium" />}}
A contest of the [[Core Gladiator Walker League]], the '''12th Solassi Interzonals Challenge Match''' was held at some point between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] and saw the teams [[Demelza's Destructors]] and [[Hansor's Hooligans]] compete against each other. During the competition, the [[gladiator walker]]s of Hooligan's captain, [[Madrix Hansor]], and Destructors' [[Jandri Garn]], both suffered damage to the point where the match was declared a draw. By two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, the contest had been the only instance of the two rival teams meeting in a competition.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|As is well known, Madrix Hansor and his four teammates have had a long-standing rivalry with Sedratis City’s premier gladiator walker team, Demelza’s Destructors.|A news report included in the fiftieth-anniversary edition of ''Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology''|<ref name="Galladinium" />}}
The 12th Solassi Interzonals Challenge Match was a [[gladiator walker]] contest of the [[Core Gladiator Walker League]].<ref name="Galladinium" /> It shared its name with the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Solassus system/Legends|Solassus system]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> and took place at some point between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="Dates" /> The contest pitted the teams [[Demelza's Destructors]] and [[Hansor's Hooligans]] against each other, with both of the teams and their captains, [[Demelza Mintori]] and [[Madrix Hansor]], being engaged in a bitter rivalry.<ref name="Galladinium" />

==The match==
{{Quote|On that occasion both Madrix Hansor and Jandri Garn, Demelza’s point guard, suffered such damage to their machines that the match was declared a draw and neither participant advanced to the next round!|A news report included in the fiftieth-anniversary edition of ''Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology''|<ref name="Galladinium" />}}
During the match, the [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] of Hansor and Demelza's point guard, [[Jandri Garn]], both suffered extensive damage to the point where the contest was declared a draw, with neither of the two participants advancing to the following round.<ref name="Galladinium" />

==Aftermath==
The 12th Solassi Interzonals Challenge Match proved to be the only occasion where individual members of Demelza's Destructors and Hansor's Hooligans had competed against each other by the [[Time/Legends|time]] when, two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, Hooligans issued a personal challenge to the Destructors. The historic match was then mentioned in a news report that was subsequently included in the [[Galladinium's 50th anniversary edition|fiftieth-anniversary edition]] of ''[[Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology]]''.<ref name="Galladinium" />

==Behind the scenes==
The 12th Solassi Interzonals Challenge Match was mentioned in ''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook authored by [[Rick D. Stuart]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Galladinium" />
